name: std::insert_iterator<Container>::operator=
intro:
Inserts the given value value to the container.

1) Results in iter = container->insert(iter, value); ++iter;.

2) Results in iter = container->insert(iter, std::move(value)); ++iter;.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function exploits the signature compatibility between hinted insert for associative containers (such as std::set::insert) and positional insert for sequential containers (such as std::vector::insert).

summary: Inserts the given value value to the container.
